items.author: Tom Orsborn
items.body_excerpt:
Mitch Johnson was non-committal when asked if he sees Tobias Harris (calf) returning before Christmas.

"For his sake, I hope so. But, yeah, again we're going to take it very methodically and whenever he comes back, it'll be later than he wanted and later than he probably could."
